    Variables:

    Objective:
    Minimize total hedging cost:
    \min \sum_{i=1}^{120} \text{Cost}[i] \cdot |x_i|

    \bigg| G_{\text{initial}} + \sum_{i=1}^{120} \sum_{j=1}^{6} G[i] \cdot A[i,j] \cdot x_i \bigg| \leq \text{Tolerance}_G

    Where:
    • G_{\text{initial}} is the initial exposure for that Greek (given).
    • G[i] is the per-contract Greek exposure of option i (from OptionCharacteristics.csv).
    • A[i,j] is from Option_AssetReferenceMatrix.csv.
    • \text{Tolerance}_G is the band for each risk metric (given).

    Trading limits:
    \text{MaxShort}[i] \leq x_i \leq \text{MaxLong}[i], \quad i=1,\dots,120

    Data provided:
    • OptionCharacteristics.csv: Option, Cost, Delta, Gamma, Vega, MaxLong, MaxShort
    • Option_AssetReferenceMatrix.csv: binary matrix (120 × 6) showing which option references which asset (A[i,j])
    • Initial net Delta = 0.25, Gamma = 0.08, Vega = 0.17
    • Risk band tolerances: |\Delta| \le 0.06,\ |\Gamma| \le 0.05,\ |\text{Vega}| \le 0.07

    Task:
    Find the optimal integer positions x_i,\ i=1,\dots,120 that minimize total hedging cost, such that all risk exposures after hedging are within their respective bands, while respecting per-option trading limits and using the asset-reference information in the constraints.
